what: blaze-vfs Vfs::restore (crates/blaze-vfs/src/image.rs:196-233) passes over an image that does not open, that the journal does not start from, or whose disks section is refused, and loads the journal alone (same tree, slower start); the reason is only in Recovered::image (ImageUse::Refused/Unnamed, disks: Some(why)). The daemon (crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/daemon.rs, where it reads ImageUse) should make a refused or corrupt image an error naming why, not a quiet slower start (no-fallback: a slow path when the fast one refuses). ImageUse::None (no image yet) stays a cold start.

history.note: already in the tree (no-fallback-link-cargo): daemon.rs vfs_used: ImageUse::Unnamed, Corrupt, Malformed are StartError::Image(ImageFault::Vfs(VfsFault::..)); ImageUse::None/Unopened stay; ImageUse::Refused (missing section or another schema, the same rule as the database) is Started::tree, printed at start. A disks refusal is Started::disks: blaze-vfs open_disks gives it only as a String, so a corrupt disks section cannot yet be told from another schema; that is 01169 (owner vfs). Tests: daemon.rs vfs_used tests.
